── netforge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Interactive wizard for the NetForge dotnet template.

Usage
  netforge new                 Start the interactive wizard
  netforge new <flags> --yes    Scaffold non-interactively (CI/scripts)
  netforge new <flags> --dry-run Print the command only, don't run
  netforge --version | --help

Non-interactive flags (defaults: --tier pro --database sqlite)
  -n, --name <name>          Project name (default MyApp)
  --tier pro|basic
  --database sqlite|postgres|sqlserver   --dev-split
  --with <feat,…>            Turn features on  (e.g. dashboard,webhooks)
  --without <feat,…>         Turn features off
  --no-oauth <Google,…>      Drop OAuth providers
  --brand-color #6d28d9      --theme zinc|ocean|forest|sunset

Features: audit, notifications, webhooks, search, dashboard, export, 
fileuploads, jobs, advancedauth, multitenant, pwa, tour, changelog, appearance, 
demo
First run? Install the free template once: dotnet new install NetForge.Templates
